d: Watch this Classic Hindi Song 'Dhiktana' starring Salman Khan & Madhuri Dixit from Superhit Bollywood movie Hum Aapke Hain Koun (1993). The movie is directed by Sooraj Barjatya and the music is composed by Ram Laxman. The film also stars Mohnish Bahl, Renuka Shahane, Anupam Kher, Reema Lagoo, Alok Nath, Lakshmikant Berde. The lyrics are penned by Ravinder Rawal. Song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar, S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, Udit Narayan, Shailender Singh.
